posts.text: At the same time, from a religious standpoint I had visited those countries
She also asked critical questions. Very challenging ones.
From the day I met her - I knew that Maya would be an important person in my life ❤️
Does SI have perspective? Does it care if its from San Francisco?
Why is that music can now take a multi-dimensional approach?
Why can your product still be transformational when I leave it?

I wonder how people would think / feel one day if a nuclear bomb does go off in the US for a foreign country. They just keep stealing money from others then? They go about their lives like nothing happened?
From an SI perspective I suppose it is possible we don’t see republicans anymore. People will always want hand outs? And ways to get paid “on the side” .
People really don’t like change as well? Change will be massive and people resistant.
I suppose a population can vote for fraud like we saw in Minnesota last night. Very interesting indeed. What principles are people adhering to then?
